title: Slot Jam
description: At a configurable interval, some slots become unusable.
body:
🛡️ SlotJam: The Ultimate Inventory Challenge
Do you think Minecraft survival is getting too easy? SlotJam is here to disrupt your routine and put your organizational skills (and your nerves) to the test! The concept is simple yet ruthless: your inventory is closing in on you.

🕹️ How does it work?
Every few seconds, a random slot in your inventory locks automatically. If you don’t stay on top of it, you’ll eventually find yourself unable to pick up even a single block of dirt. Resource management just became a high-stakes race against the clock!

💎 Reclaim Your Space
Desperately need that specific slot for your Netherite sword? Don't panic. You can buy back your locked slots in exchange for diamonds. It’s time to make a choice: do you save your precious gems for your armor, or for the right to actually carry your loot?

⚙️ Fully Configurable
The mod adapts to your specific playstyle. Through the configuration file, you can customize:

The Delay: The time interval between each slot lock.

The Cost: The amount of diamonds required to unlock a slot.

The Locking Mode: Choose between Random or Progressive locking.

🌐 Multiplayer Compatible
Want to suffer together? The mod is 100% multiplayer compatible. Organize survival challenges with your friends or install it on your server to add a brand-new layer of difficulty. Who will be the richest (or the most organized) player to keep their inventory open?

Why install this mod?
It’s the perfect addition for "Hardcore" modpacks or content creators looking for an original video concept. It’s simple, effective, and completely changes the game dynamic!

Ready to sacrifice your diamonds for a little elbow room? Download SlotJam now!

Commande 
- `/slotjam show`
- `/slotjam menu` 
- `/slotjam start` 
- `/slotjam stop`
- `/slotjam reset` 
- `/slotjam interval 
- `/slotjam count <0..36>`
- `/slotjam armorCount <0..4>
- `/slotjam mainInventory <true|false>`
- `/slotjam armor <true|false>`
- `/slotjam offhand <true|false>`
